headline: Turning your WhatsApp orders from 600 grocery outlets into clean dispatch lists
intro: A short page for your team, following our LinkedIn chat. It shows what we would build for you in a week, on a sample of your own data.
noticed: Your sales team takes orders from retailers and restaurants on WhatsApp, often as voice-typed lists in English or Hindi.
Prices change weekly and are kept in a sheet, so every order is re-typed and checked by hand before dispatch.
week: An agent that reads 200 of your past order chats and turns each into order lines matched to your product codes
One clarifying message when an item or pack size is unclear, instead of a phone call
A dispatch sheet your warehouse can use the next morning, with a count of orders it could not read
need: An export of about 200 recent order chats
Your current product list with codes and prices
30 minutes with the person who handles orders today
